topic: Fill Last-Minute Salon Slots Using an Instagram DM Automation (No Appointments App)
title: Fill Last-Minute Salon Slots With One Instagram DM Trick
title_options: Fill Tonight's Salon Slots With Instagram DMs
Last-Minute Salon Bookings Using One DM Auto-Reply
How to Fill Empty Salon Chairs Fast With Instagram
description:
A quick, low-cost way to turn empty salon slots into bookings using Instagram DMs. No booking app needed — just one automated reply and a simple booking flow.

Includes a word-for-word DM template you can copy, plus a real example for a nail salon. Works for stylists, barbers, massage therapists, and more.

scenes.doodle_prompt: stylist next to an empty salon chair, wall clock

scenes.narration: Set one Instagram DM auto-reply for the word 'OPEN' that lists two live slots and asks them to reply to hold.
scenes.visual_query: woman typing on phone at salon

scenes.narration: Example for a nail salon: auto-reply says, 'Hi! We have 5:30PM gel or 7PM manicure. Reply 1 for 5:30 or 2 for 7 to hold.'
When they reply '1' type a quick saved reply: 'Held for you — arrive 10 minutes early. Confirm with a card on arrival.'
scenes.visual_query: phone showing message thread in hand
scenes.doodle_prompt: phone sending messages to nearby houses, map pin

scenes.narration: Cost: zero if you use built-in auto-replies. Result: faster confirmations and fewer empty chairs. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
